# Patient Care Monitoring Note — 04/18/2026
Westbrook Regional Care Center | Room 214 | Day shift

## Patient and orders
Patient: Maria Navarro, 72 | MRN: WB-60418
Allergies: sulfa drugs
Admitting diagnosis: right ankle fracture, nonoperative management

| Monitoring item | Current order or reference |
| --- | --- |
| Diet | Consistent-carbohydrate, 60 g per meal |
| Activity | Up with one-person assist; weight bearing as tolerated on right leg |
| Fall precautions | Bed alarm on; nonskid footwear for transfers |
| Baseline vitals, 0600 | BP 138/76 mmHg; pulse 82/min; respirations 16/min; temperature 98.4°F; SpO2 97% on room air |

## Shift observations
At 0700, breakfast intake was documented as 100% before the tray arrived at 0735. Patient was alert and oriented to person, place, time, and situation. Right ankle swelling remained mild; toes warm, capillary refill under 2 seconds, and sensation intact. She denied numbness or new pain. At 0815, she transferred from bed to chair with one-person assistance and a walker; gait was steady, with no loss of balance.

Although the order specifies a consistent-carbohydrate diet, the patient received and ate a regular breakfast with approximately 75 g carbohydrate. She drank 240 mL water with the meal and had no nausea. At 1030, BP was 132/74 mmHg, pulse 78/min, and SpO2 97% on room air. She walked 40 ft in the hall with the walker and one-person assistance, then rested in the chair.

At 1115, Maria reported ankle pain of 7/10. Hydrocodone 5 mg by mouth was administered per the PRN order. The shift record contains no post-dose pain reassessment. At 1200, she was resting in bed with the bed alarm on; call light was within reach. Wendy Whitfield, RN, received handoff at 1500.

errors.quote: breakfast intake was documented as 100% before the tray arrived
errors.explanation: The note says intake was documented at 0700, but the tray did not arrive until 0735. Recording meal intake before it occurs is inaccurate documentation and violates the requirement to maintain a truthful patient record.
errors.fix: breakfast intake was documented after the tray arrived

errors.quote: the patient received and ate a regular breakfast
errors.explanation: The order table specifies a consistent-carbohydrate diet of 60 g per meal, but this sentence says she received and ate a regular breakfast with about 75 g carbohydrate. The documented meal conflicts with the ordered diet.
errors.fix: the patient received and ate a consistent-carbohydrate breakfast

errors.quote: Hydrocodone 5 mg by mouth was administered per the PRN order.
errors.explanation: The note records a PRN opioid given for pain rated 7/10 but does not document reassessment of pain and response after administration. The record needs the post-dose pain score and reassessment time.
errors.fix: Hydrocodone 5 mg by mouth was administered per the PRN order; pain was reassessed at 1200 and was 3/10.
